parsed.rationale: Regular sinus rhythm at about 60 bpm with narrow QRS and no reciprocal ST depression; the only ST elevation is minimal (about 1 mm), concave and confined to V2-V3 beside deep S waves and tall T waves, so it is a normal early-repolarization variant and falls below STEMI criteria, which does not support the team's STEMI read.
